endpoints.name: Create
endpoints.business_purpose: Create a new vehicle type record

idempotency.notes: Not idempotent; a duplicate check exists so repeating usually fails with a conflict/validation message

endpoints.short_description: Create a new vehicle type record
endpoints.detailed_description: Create a new vehicle type record. It validates the request, then checks for an existing/duplicate record, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IVehicleTypeRepository.IsVehicleTypeDuplicateAsync, IVehicleTypeRepository.CreateVehicleTypeAsync, then writes an audit log entry. Persists changes to: VehicleType: INSERT, AuditLog: INSERT. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 500.

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Invalid data provided. [when !ModelState.IsValid]; Vehicle type is required. [when string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.vehicle_type)]; message returned by the called service/repository (result.Message)
error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Unauthorized: No token provided. [when current_user == null]
error_handling.business_rule_errors: Vehicle type with this name already exists. [when dupcheck]

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to create a new vehicle type record
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to view data, or the required inputs are not available yet
